mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lymph drainage network was worthwhile because it showed a continuous route from around cells back to a vein and explained why that return matters.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to connect the draining tissue spaces directly to the larger vessels was confusing: the pictures suggested a connection, but it was not available in that order.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the tissue spaces could not connect to anything at first, but could join the completed lymph return route later. I also learned that the fluid is called lymph once it enters those vessels.

arbitrary.text: The need to connect the larger lymph vessels to the vein before joining them to the draining tissue spaces felt like an unexplained ordering requirement, even though the final route made sense.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing nerves, blood supply and fluid return come together made me curious about how another body system would fit into the model.
